text_blocks.snippet: High cholesterol and high blood pressure are both significant risk factors for heart disease and stroke, and they often occur together. High cholesterol can lead to the buildup of plaque in arteries, making it harder for blood to flow and causing blood pressure to rise. Conversely, high blood pressure can damage artery walls, creating places where cholesterol can accumulate.
snippet_highlighted_words: High cholesterol can lead to the buildup of plaque in arteries, making it harder for blood to flow and causing blood pressure to rise

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a more detailed look at the connection:

list.title: High cholesterol:
list.snippet: A waxy substance found in your blood, it's essential for building cells and hormones, but too much can lead to plaque buildup in arteries.

list.title: High blood pressure:
list.snippet: When blood pressure is consistently too high, it can damage blood vessels and make the heart work harder.

list.title: The Interplay:
list.snippet: High cholesterol can cause arteries to narrow and stiffen, making it harder for the heart to pump blood, leading to higher blood pressure. High blood pressure can also damage artery walls, creating areas where cholesterol can accumulate, further exacerbating the problem.

list.title: Consequences:
list.snippet: Both high cholesterol and high blood pressure can increase the risk of heart attacks, strokes, and other cardiovascular problems.

list.title: Lifestyle changes:
list.snippet: Diet and exercise are crucial for managing both conditions.

list.title: Diet:
list.snippet: Reducing saturated and trans fats, increasing soluble fiber, and incorporating foods rich in omega-3 fatty acids can help lower cholesterol.

list.title: Exercise:
list.snippet: Regular physical activity can help lower both cholesterol and blood pressure.

list.title: Weight management:
list.snippet: Maintaining a moderate weight is important for overall cardiovascular health.

list.title: Medication:
list.snippet: In some cases, medication may be necessary to manage cholesterol and/or blood pressure levels.
